lines:
flowchart TD
  A[Open Settings from any non-Settings surface] --> B[Capture origin view once and retain mounted surface]
  B --> C[Settings visit with Back]
  C -->|Repeated Settings entry or section change| C
  C -->|Back, unhandled Escape, or explicit navigation| D{Mutation pending?}
  D -->|Yes| E[Reconcile existing command without duplicate dispatch]
  E -->|Failure or uncertain| C
  E -->|Verified success| F{Dirty draft?}
  D -->|No| F
  F -->|No| J[Dispose visit notices and secret inputs]
  F -->|Yes| G[Save and return / Discard and return / Stay in Settings]
  G -->|Stay| C
  G -->|Save| H[Validate and save with expected version]
  H -->|Conflict, validation, failure, or uncertainty| C
  H -->|Receipt and snapshot prove success| J
  G -->|Discard| I[Restore latest canonical Settings and appearance]
  I -->|Failure| C
  I -->|Success| J
  J --> K[Restore destination identity, panes, scroll anchor, and focus]
  K --> L[Continue current runtime with original workspace drafts intact]

data.title: Settings visit and exact workspace return
